svg.title: JARVIS Windows Local. A Windows desktop assistant with local Ollama reasoning, voice control, transcription, SQLite memory, and policy-gated actions.
svg.desc: A Windows-first desktop assistant built with PySide6. It combines local Ollama reasoning, faster-whisper transcription, SQLite memory, wake-word voice control, policy-gated actions, and a scoped Claude Code handoff. Windows builds use PyInstaller and Inno Setup. Technologies: Python, PySide6, Ollama, faster-whisper, SQLite. Open repository.
